name: Bizagi level 2 - time analysis
description: Reconstructs https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/level_2_example.htm with processing times and infinite resources. Arrivals are constant every 5 minutes: processvalidation47.png reports exactly 2017 started and completed instances (10080/5 + 1). The advanced exponential setting belongs to the separate generic 100-token example. No duration is set, allowing all cases to drain. Triage probabilities come from level_1_example.htm: Green 20%, Yellow 30%, Red 50%.
